newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to fine Irish Sugar on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: EU to fine Irish Sugar on Wednesday.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to fine Irish Sugar, a subsidiary of Greencore Group Plc, on Wednesday for abusing its dominant position in Ireland for over 10 years, Commission sources said on Tuesday.

The Commission was acting on several complaints from small sugar producers about Irish Sugar's behaviour including refusal to sell and heavy discounts aimed at eliminating competitors, the sources said. They added that the offences started in the mid 80s and were abandoned only recently.

The spokesman for European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert confirmed a firm would get a "nice fine" Wednesday for bad behaviour in the past, but declined to name it or give the size of the penalty.
The Commission can fine companies up to 10 percent of their annual turnover, depending on the importance of the offences and for how long this affected the market concerned.
